name: Aerofly Rokid HUD
summary: Aerofly FS 4 flight telemetry on the Rokid glasses HUD
description: Shows live Aerofly FS 4 telemetry on Rokid glasses over the local network, including airspeed, altitude, heading, attitude, controls, warnings, maps, and runway data. Requires Aerofly FS 4 on a Windows PC plus the matching AeroflyRokidHud.dll and AeroflyRokidRunways.dat from the same 2.6 AutoRunway bundle in the PC's external_dll directory. This is the English glasses APK; a Chinese build is also available upstream. The author confirmed hardware operation for 2.5, but has not yet reported full on-glasses validation of the 2.6 AutoRunway update. The repository notes that its source code has not been synchronized with this binary release.
author: sjkxciuciu

releases.notes: 2.6 AutoRunway English APK from the repository's release directory. Install the matching Windows DLL and runway database from the complete bundle before use. The 2.6 update has not been fully validated on Rokid hardware by the author.

listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## Aerofly Rokid HUD
Display Aerofly FS 4 speed, altitude, attitude, runway, and control information on Rokid glasses.

**PC setup required:** Install Aerofly FS 4 on Windows and copy the matching `AeroflyRokidHud.dll` and `AeroflyRokidRunways.dat` from the upstream **2.6 AutoRunway bundle** into `Documents/Aerofly FS 4/external_dll`. Connect the PC and glasses on the same LAN. This store entry provides only the English glasses APK; the full bundle and Chinese APK are linked in the upstream repository.

The author verified 2.5 on hardware but has not yet confirmed the 2.6 AutoRunway feature on glasses. The published binary is newer than the source code currently in the repository.
